caption: The drawing shows a bonnet, predominantly rendered in a soft, pale yellow-green color. The bonnet is quilted with curved, segmented sections, and a striped ribbon in yellow, green, and grayish tones is tied into a bow at the neck, with the loose ends hanging down. To the right side of the image, there are two smaller, black-line sketches showing the bonnet from the back view, both featuring the same segmented structure and ribbon ties; one sketch is slightly above the other. The background is a plain, beige or light tan color, and the composition places the colored side view of the bonnet prominently on the left and the two back-view outline sketches on the right.
title: Bonnet
